selection_reasoning: This forms a natural two-hop dependency chain: the player must first find a sheep in the environment (task 1), which when killed drops leather. Then the player must locate a villager/merchant and sell the leather (task 2). Task 2 cannot be completed without first completing task 1, since leather is obtained from sheep. This chain tests navigation, combat, and trading mechanics in a logical sequence.

edges.reason: Selling leather requires first finding a sheep to obtain leather drops; sheep are the source of the leather item needed for the trade

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find a sheep' is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near one of the sheep (at spawn-relative coords ~-7,0,7 or ~-8,0,8) and face it, modeling 'the player can see the sheep.' Target is set to (-7, 0, 7) — the closer sheep. max_distance=5 ensures the player must walk from spawn (~10 blocks away) to within 5 blocks of the sheep. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is actually looking at the sheep, not just passing nearby.

Uses inventory_has because selling leather to the leatherworker villager results in an emerald appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with only a diamond sword (no emeralds), so having ≥1 emerald proves a successful trade was completed. This is the concrete outcome of the sell action — the villager's trade gives 1 emerald for 1 leather.

scene_description: A grass field with two sheep near an oak fence (~7-8 blocks from spawn), and a small open-front oak shelter housing a leatherworker villager with a cauldron. The player spawns holding a diamond sword. The player must find and kill a sheep to obtain leather, then trade the leather with the leatherworker villager for emeralds.
task_text: Find a sheep nearby, kill it with your diamond sword to get leather, then go to the leatherworker villager in the shelter and sell the leather.
design_notes: Player spawns at origin. Sheep at (-7,0,7) and (-8,0,8) — ~10 blocks from spawn, well beyond 3-block milestone threshold. Leatherworker villager at (5,1,7) inside open-front shelter with cauldron job site block. Trade: 1 leather → 1 emerald (Count:1b with minecraft: prefix). Diamond sword provided for killing sheep. Oak fence at x=-9 provides visual boundary. Scene expanded to 10-block radius for more space.
